summary: Retest of the HIGH bug from iteration 7: the trip-type switch does not swap points. The fix is NOT applied. /app/frontend/src/components/BookingFields.jsx line 37 still reads `[value.trip_type, v].sort().join() === "go,return"`, so it only swaps for go<->return, and git shows no change to the file. Reproduced in the UI with a TEST_ student (saved HOME 34.0101,44.1401 and UNI 33.3101,44.3701) in the student new booking dialog. Starting on go: pickup=HOME, dropoff=UNI. go->round keeps the points (OK). round->return does NOT swap (FAIL): pickup is still HOME and dropoff is still UNI. return->round has nothing to swap back. go->return swaps correctly and return->go swaps back. The admin booking dialog (BookingsSection.jsx) uses the same BookingFields component, so it has the same defect. I did not save a booking, because a return booking reached through round would store swapped home/uni places (as reproduced in iteration 7).
